text:
eva: quick note Opened PR to fix failing console examples in the playground. yaml panels reference old metric `latency_ms` and our tracehook snippets still use `trace_id_header`. small rename and an explanatory note, hoping to merge today.

noah: link? ran into this during a customer walkthrough.

eva: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5112 -- summary: rename metric to p50_latency_ms, include p95 as collapsed extra_series; rename tracehook param trace_id_header -> trace_key_header across py/go/rust samples; add compat mention.

zia: saw a build-bot alert earlier, the playground preview failed with a render error for the example dashboard.

build-bot: CI: docs build failed  broken example: missing metric "latency_ms" in dashboard_examples.yaml; linkcheck: /console/observability/old-guides/latency -> 404

eva: old vs new yaml snippet:```yaml
# old
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: latency_ms
# new
panels:
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p50_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p50_latency_ms
  - type: timeseries
    query: avg(p95_latency_ms{service="console"}) by (route)
    label: p95_latency_ms
    display: extra_series
```

eva: python tracehook change:```python
# old
TraceHook(header='x-trace', trace_id_header='x-trace')
# new
TraceHook(header='x-trace', trace_key_header='x-trace-key')
```

noah: can you also include a Rust example? we just added a rust snippet in the quickstart.

eva: added rust shim note:```rust
// old
let th = TraceHook::new().with_trace_id_header("x-trace");
// new
let th = TraceHook::new().with_trace_key_header("x-trace-key");
// compat: with_trace_id_header still accepted but deprecated
```

zia: UX note: put a single-sentence guidance below the chart: "Prefer p50 for median latency; use p95 to inspect tail latency. Keep p95 collapsed to reduce noise."

eva: added that. Also added a troubleshooting bullet: "If panel is blank, confirm your telemetry exporter emits p50_latency_ms/p95_latency_ms and not legacy names."

docs-bot: PR updated by eva (lint & linkcheck). Linkcheck still flags an external blog link with 410.

noah: replace the blog link with our internal perf primer or remove; don't leave a 410.

eva: swapped to internal perf primer and fixed a yaml escaping nit per zia's review. PTAL.

docs-bot: PR merged by eva (docs CI: success). Site deploy scheduled for 2026-04-07 05:00 UTC.

eva: thanks all  closing thread, will follow up if infra needs a metric-deprecation sweep.
